senses.gloss: (calendar) חָסֵר a defective month (of 29 days), opp. מלא of thirty days.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>ואיחליף מלא לח׳ …</he> and he made a mistake between a full and a defective month (thought it was the thirtieth day of the preceding month).
R. Hash. 19ᵇ; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.

senses.gloss: (orthogr.) a defective writing, omission of the vowel letter, opp. מלא (plene), e. g. חֹדֶשׁ, plene חוֹדֶשׁ.—Pl. f. חֲסֵירוֹת.
units: Erub. 13ᵃ; Kidd. 30ᵃ ח׳ ויתרות the rules concerning defective and plene; a. fr.
